name: TaskRow
description: One active task row. Two stacked sub-rows: top has a circular check, title (medium weight), an edit pencil, the due-date control, and a drag handle. Meta row (indented) shows the created-date chip and, if dueState != none, a colored due badge like 'Overdue · Aug 28, 2026'. The whole row gets a translucent tint of the due color when dueState is overdue/today/tomorrow. A faint monospace debug task id sits below.

dueLabel.description: Full label shown inside the due pill, e.g. 'Overdue · Aug 28, 2026'.

taskId.description: Lowercased task id rendered as the debug line.
